newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia DCB cuts base rate to 9.15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia DCB cuts base rate to 9.15 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's DCB Bank Bhd said it was reducing its base lending rate to 9.15 percent from 9.20 beginning on November 4.
In a statement on Monday, the banking arm of listed DCB Holdings Bhd said the revision is to reflect prevailing interbank rates.
The bank said its one-month fixed deposit rate will be quoted at the unchanged rate of 7.10 percent.
The three-, six- and nine-month rates are reduced to 7.20 percent from 7.30.
Its 12-month rate is trimmed to 7.20 percent from 7.25, the statement said.
